checks: managers attach photos; bytes are stored privately with a matching SHA-256
the upload is recorded in the campus audit log
assigned technicians can attach and read; others cannot see the incident
only the uploader or a manager can delete; deletion is soft and audited
provenance is immutable and records cannot be hard-deleted or restored
tampered stored bytes fail the integrity check and are not served
invalid files are rejected before anything is stored
per-incident limits are enforced and the rejected upload leaves no orphaned file
closed incidents and completed work orders do not accept new evidence
attachments from earlier scenario generations stay readable by managers only
S3-compatible storage driver stores, reads and deletes signed objects
storage: temporary local directory and local fake S3 endpoint; no cloud object store contacted
